long_biography.plain_text:
Maurizio Gucci divested his final half-interest in Gucci to Investcorp in 1993. Consequently, the estate later received by Allegra Gucci did not contain a continuing stake in the fashion house. The company subsequently became part of Kering. Her inherited capital therefore has historical roots in fashion retail, but neither the brand's current assets nor its commercial performance belongs to her.

Allegra graduated in law at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore in Milan. Her identifiable independent work is authorship. Piemme issued Fine dei giochi in 2022, and she pledged the book's proceeds to a children's foundation.
